comment: Cards the daily snapshot job prices (POCKETFOLIO-PRICING.md §3). The app is backendless, so CI cannot know what users hold — add the cards you own here (Settings lists the ones missing and copies these rows for you). `id` is the pokemontcg.io card id the app stores on holdings. `setTotal` is the printed set size (the 102 in 4/102): a row from a set of another size is rejected, because a card number alone matched Base Set 2 for a Base Set Charizard. `setMatch` is a fragment the matched row's set name must contain — promos carry no `x/y` numbering, so it is the only guard against binding to a same-named card from another set. `pptSetId` pins PPT's own set id when a name search keeps landing on the wrong printing. `image` pins a picture when the provider has no usable scan — the Japanese catalog is missing many, and a reprint that shares the artwork beats an empty box; it never changes what is priced. `pcQuery` overrides the auto-built PriceCharting search. A JAPANESE print gets its own entry: the English id with an `@jp` suffix plus `language: "japanese"` — the app reads the @jp snapshot entry for holdings flagged as Japanese slabs.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.pcQuery: togepi corocoro comics japanese promo pokemon

cards.name: The Boss's Way
cards.pcQuery: the boss's way team rocket 73/82 pokemon

cards.name: Umbreon VMAX
cards.pcQuery: umbreon vmax alt art evolving skies 215/203 pokemon
